history.summary: A very large 2,282 sqft 4BR (likely an EC-style/Punggol exec format) at $2.8M / $1,227 psf in D19. Low PSF looks cheap but is driven by the oversized floor area, and at $2.8M quantum in Punggol the buyer pool is shallow.
history.rating_rationale: The $1,227 psf headline is the lowest in the batch but that is a function of the 2,282 sqft size, not genuine cheapness — this is an oversized unit masquerading as cheap PSF. At $2.8M the quantum is at the very top of what Punggol/D19 absorbs, where the buyer pool is thin; D19 ceiling prices are HDB-upgrader-constrained. No URA appreciation or txn data in the dossier, so the growth rate is unverified. Plus side: Punggol Digital District and CRL (~2030) are real long-term catalysts, and 170m to Kadaloor LRT adds convenience, but those accrue more to mid-quantum units than to a $2.8M jumbo.
red_flags: Oversized 2,282 sqft drives the low PSF — not genuine value
$2.8M quantum near the D19/Punggol price ceiling, shallow exit pool
No URA appreciation/txn data; growth unverified
